description: A single-image process-flow schematic (no axes, no scale bar, no data curves) titled "Schematic diagram of hot rolling and heat treatment", drawn on a pale pink-to-blue gradient background. The main horizontal route reads left to right: a white ingot → "Homogenizing 1200°C for 2h" (orange furnace containing a red block) → a rolling mill stand (two grey rolls marked with "+" symbols) → "Hot-rolling to 6mm" (red slab) → "Air-cooled" (grey-blue slab). From the air-cooled slab two dashed arrows branch: upward, "① Single-stage heat treatment S1000、S1050、S1100", into a framed box reading "keeping at 1000、1050、1100°C for 3min then quenching to room temperature" (orange furnace holding three samples → blue quench tank); and downward, "② Multi-stage heat treatment MHT", into a three-box sub-route drawn right-to-left with leftward arrows: "I: first heat treatment" — "keeping at 1000°C for 3min then quenching to room temperature"; "II: secondary heat treatment" — "keeping at 750°C for 15min then quenching to room temperature"; "III: third heat treatment" — "keeping at 1050°C for 3min then quenching to room temperature". Each of I, II, III is drawn as an orange furnace plus a blue water-quenching bath. The figure defines the two processing schedules compared in the paper.

observations.observation: The whole figure is a processing-route schematic, not a data plot: it contains no axes, no numeric data points and no scale bar, only labelled boxes and arrows.
The main horizontal route is drawn as ingot → 'Homogenizing 1200°C for 2h' → rolling mill → 'Hot-rolling to 6mm' → 'Air-cooled'.
The figure box title is 'Schematic diagram of hot rolling and heat treatment'.
Two dashed branches leave the air-cooled slab, labelled '① Single-stage heat treatment S1000、S1050、S1100' and '② Multi-stage heat treatment MHT'.
The single-stage box reads 'keeping at 1000、1050、1100°C for 3min then quenching to room temperature' and depicts a furnace holding three samples followed by a quenching tank.

The multi-stage sub-route is laid out right to left with leftward arrows in the order I: first heat treatment (1000°C, 3min, quench), II: secondary heat treatment (750°C, 15min, quench), III: third heat treatment (1050°C, 3min, quench).
Every heat-treatment step in the figure is followed by 'quenching to room temperature', shown iconographically as a blue water bath.
The caption states this is 'Fig. 1. Schematic diagram of hot rolling and heat treatment'.
The cited text states the ingot was homogenized at 1200 °C for 2 h and then hot rolled at 1050–950 °C to produce a 6 mm sheet, followed by air cooling to room temperature.

The cited text states the single-stage treatments were 1000 °C/3 min (S1000), 1050 °C/3 min (S1050) and 1100 °C/3 min (S1100), each quenched to room temperature, and were performed 'for comparison of tensile properties only'.
The cited text states the multi-stage heat treatment (MHT) is 1000 °C/3 min (first stage) → 750 °C/15 min (secondary stage) → 1050 °C/3 min (tertiary stage), each quenched to room temperature.

The cited text gives the nominal steel composition as Fe–20Mn–9Al-1.5C–2Ni–3Cr (analyzed Fe-20.3Mn-8.6Al-1.4C-2.1Ni-2.9Cr in wt.%) and a measured density of 6.78 g/cm3, about 14 % lower than pure iron (7.87 g/cm3).
